## The same role under another name

If a document uses another name, read it as the role in this playbook.

| In this playbook | Also called |
|------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Critical friend** | Analytical assurer, the term used in the standards |
| **Analysis Senior Responsible Officer** | Model Senior Responsible Officer (Business Critical documentation), Senior Responsible Owner, or SRO (draft Analytical Governance and Quality Assurance Policy, and NHSBSA's overview of the Business Critical process), approver (AQuA Book) |

: Role names used in this playbook and the other names for them

## When you disagree

If you disagree, use the escalation route in the table.

| Disagreement | Goes to |
|---|---|
| The assurance level | The Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead |
| Whether an impact dimension scores 4, which makes the analysis Business Critical | The commissioner decides. Escalate to the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead if unresolved |
| Whether the analysis is fit for purpose | The critical friend advises. Unresolved, escalate to the Lead Official for Statistics |
| Whether there is enough time for the assurance required | The commissioner, then the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead |
| An ethical concern | The commissioner decides. Unresolved, the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead, or the Lead Official for Statistics where the output is an official statistic |

: Kinds of disagreement and where each one goes

If the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead is unavailable, raise the disagreement through your own line while you wait.

**Do not lower the assurance level to meet a deadline.** Narrow the question instead, or say plainly what assurance you did not do.

## Who holds the organisational roles

Three roles are held for NHSBSA as a whole:

- the Analytical Quality and Assurance Lead
- the Lead Official for Statistics
- the senior officer accountable for analysis as an activity, not for approving any one output

NHSBSA's governance and management framework records who holds them. If you do not know who holds one, see [who to ask](../09-resources/r3-who-to-ask.qmd).
